notes.title: April 21, 0.55v - UI Keybind Hints, Improved Settings, In-game music Control
notes.content:
Added UI key bind hints to help with usability
 UI key bind goes black when open and white when closed
 Added In-game music control, You are able to disable key binds (Settings don't save but will be able to in the future.
 You can now tab out and not have the game freeze
 Music in main game has been added and is functioning
 Slime Wars added to Unity Intro
 You can now zoom in and out! Also your camera spawns on your base.

notes.title: April 9th, 0.51v - Early access banner, Major UI changes and Data saving
notes.content:
Todays update includes a few mini updates I didn't write about.

The changes

 Fixed Exp bar stretching
 Fixed Research UI overlapping
 Fixed Stats saving. It now fully saves to your steam account and your account username will be your steam account name
 Fixed transparency of unit queue
 Removed unit counter, will add a unit timer instead eventually
 Fixed canon rotating from base not the barrel
 Changed Wizard Damage and Speed
 Changed Mega Fighter Speed
 Added Alpha Banner to shop


Also! I saw a transaction go through for something I thought wasnt active. I quickly made a banner and set it up to give whoever bought it the banner. The banner is also available to purchase in the store and will be limited time. Only available in this "Alpha" version before the actual game is released. No obligation to buy it, just for anyone that wants to and is able to support in that way. Thank you guys!

The banner also will be available of course in the final build in the regular game. You will have it in both the playtest and the regular slime wars.
